paragraphs: Soft-Pak sells a suite of operational software built for waste hauling companies. The software keeps customer service, billing, routing and operational information in one system, and it runs either on a hauler's own server or on the cloud. Mobile-Pak is the in-cab computing product for hauler fleets. Map-Pak is the product named for waste hauler routing.

Buyers named on the site range from a small, privately owned garbage company to a large corporate waste company or a roll-off hauler. Municipal operations appear in the same list, next to an industry-top hauler and a mid-size hauler with a single facility. A testimonial on the homepage carries the name Gina Moore, City of Glenndale, CA.

The about page dates i-Pak to 2001 and the move of the application to the cloud to 2005. Terex Corporation acquired Environmental Solutions Group. Connected Collections is presented as work from Environmental Solutions Group companies.

quote.text: THE software solution created specifically for waste haulers.
